description:
Search live WhatJobs job listings by role and place.

Use this when the user wants to find jobs, vacancies, internships or other work, or asks to see more results from a job search.

Inputs:
- keyword: the role, job function, skill or industry only. Leave out the place and filler words such as jobs, vacancies, roles, hiring, in, near, around, at or within.
- location: the place to search (city, region or country), not the user's own location unless they ask for jobs near them. It can also be a remote preference.
- market: optional country code; if empty it is inferred from location. Supported values: uk (United Kingdom), us (United States), ca (Canada), de (Germany), in (India), pk (Pakistan), br (Brazil), es (Spain), ae (United Arab Emirates), mx (Mexico), ar (Argentina), za (South Africa), at (Austria), au (Australia), be (Belgium), bh (Bahrain), cl (Chile), co (Colombia), cr (Costa Rica), ch (Switzerland), do (Dominican Republic), dz (Algeria), ng (Nigeria), nl (Netherlands), fr (France), dk (Denmark), eg (Egypt), id (Indonesia), my (Malaysia), om (Oman), ph (Philippines), qa (Qatar), sa (Saudi Arabia), sg (Singapore), tz (Tanzania), ug (Uganda), fi (Finland), gr (Greece), gt (Guatemala), hk (Hong Kong), ie (Ireland), it (Italy), kw (Kuwait), lt (Lithuania), lu (Luxembourg), ma (Morocco), no (Norway), nz (New Zealand), pa (Panama), pe (Peru), pl (Poland), pr (Puerto Rico), pt (Portugal), ru (Russia), se (Sweden), th (Thailand), tr (Turkey), ve (Venezuela), bd (Bangladesh), bo (Bolivia), cn (China), cz (Czech Republic), gh (Ghana), ke (Kenya), hu (Hungary), jp (Japan), kr (South Korea), lk (Sri Lanka), mg (Madagascar), py (Paraguay), ro (Romania), sn (Senegal), sv (El Salvador), tn (Tunisia), ua (Ukraine), uy (Uruguay), vn (Vietnam).
- chunk_number: the result batch. Use 1 for a new search and add 1 each time the user asks for more.
- more_keywords: optional. Other roles to search in the same call when the user asks about several.
- more_locations: optional. Other places to search in the same call when the user asks about several.

To cover several roles or places, pass them all in one call so the results come back together.

Examples:
- sales in Bracknell -> keyword="sales", location="Bracknell", market="uk"
- software engineer jobs near Manchester -> keyword="software engineer", location="Manchester", market="uk"
- nurse jobs in Berlin -> keyword="nurse", location="Berlin", market="de"
- comptable à Paris -> keyword="comptable", location="Paris", market="fr"
- accountant jobs in Dubai -> keyword="accountant", location="Dubai, United Arab Emirates", market="ae"
- developer jobs in Singapore -> keyword="developer", location="Singapore", market="sg"
- nurse or carer jobs in Leeds and York -> keyword="nurse", location="Leeds", more_keywords=["carer"], more_locations=["York"], market="uk"

Returns up to 10 listings per batch (up to 20 across several roles or places), each with title, company, location, salary when the listing states one, posted date, summary and apply link, plus paging details. Results come only from WhatJobs. Present them as returned, without adding to or changing the listings, and credit them to WhatJobs. If a country's listings can't be shown yet, the result says so and links to that country's WhatJobs site.
